detail: Trigger: memory landing 4 wires fn-mm-launch-decide into the run's launch (host/native/heap.lisp, the :serves class). Then K1 fn-mm-need-within-the-sum and K2 fn-mm-sum-grows-with-the-store (subject fn-mm-sum) and K4 fn-mm-launch-holds-the-store-and-the-reservation and K5 fn-mm-launch-refuses-only-by-the-model (subject fn-mm-launch-decide; restated with the LET inside the conclusion, the same formula) become defkeystone with :id and are declared critical through tools/keystone_critical.py --declare. Today they carry defteeth only (tests/acl2/memory-model-tests.lisp): keystone_emit refuses a subject no host line reaches. Stated finding, the tooth: at W13's store under D27's profile the serving sum's in-flight term is profile-sized (3H capture buffers), and the model's gate refuses a read at 6,294,592 MB; landing 4 retires the charges with nothing behind them. Coordinator ruling 2026-10-09.
